facturasnube-active-help: While disabled, no invoice is queued or uploaded.
facturasnube-auth-denied: You cancelled the authorisation in Google.
facturasnube-auth-error: The connection to Google Drive could not be completed. Check the log for details.
facturasnube-connect-help: Create web application OAuth credentials in Google Cloud Console, paste the Client ID and Client secret here, save, and press the button to authorise access.
facturasnube-cron-result: Invoices uploaded to the cloud: %ok%. Failed: %error%.
facturasnube-enqueue-all-help: Leave the date empty to queue every customer invoice.
facturasnube-file-name-help: Supports {codigo}, {numero}, {fecha}, {cliente} and {nif}. The .pdf extension is added automatically.
facturasnube-folder-error: The folder %name% could not be created or found in the cloud.
facturasnube-historic-help: Invoices that already existed before the plugin was installed are swept a few at a time on every run, with no need to queue them by hand.
facturasnube-missing-credentials: The Client ID and Client secret must be saved before connecting.
facturasnube-no-refresh-token: Google did not return a refresh token. Revoke the app's access in your Google account and connect again.
facturasnube-on-delete-trash: Move the file to the bin
facturasnube-pdf-error: The invoice PDF could not be generated.
facturasnube-redirect-uri-help: Copy this exact value into the OAuth credentials in Google Cloud Console. If it does not match, Google will reject the connection. It comes from the site url configured in the company settings.
facturasnube-retry-errors-help: Puts back in the queue the ones that ran out of retries.
facturasnube-root-folder-id-help: Id of the Drive folder where invoices are stored. Leave it empty to let the plugin create its own folder.
facturasnube-root-folder-name: Name of the folder to create
facturasnube-scope-changed: You changed the permissions, but the connected account still holds the previous ones. Disconnect and connect again to apply them.
facturasnube-scope-file: Only the files the plugin creates (recommended)
facturasnube-scope-folder-conflict: With the minimum permission the plugin cannot see folders it did not create. Leave the target folder id empty or switch to full access.
facturasnube-scope-help: With the recommended option Google does not require app verification, but the plugin can only use the folder it creates itself: leave the target folder id empty.
facturasnube-secret-help: Leave it empty to keep the stored secret.
facturasnube-start-date-help: Invoices older than this date are never uploaded, not even when edited. Leave it empty to include them all.
facturasnube-state-error: Google's response does not match the request. Please try again.
facturasnube-sync-now-help: Processes the queue without waiting for the cron.
facturasnube-upload-error: The cloud did not return the uploaded file id.
